name: Demetrius II Aetolicus
contribution: King of the Ancient Greek kingdom of Macedonia from 239 until his death in 229 BC.

checks.lead: Demetrius II (Greek: Δημήτριος, romanized: Demetrios; c. 275 - 229 BC), also known as Demetrius Aetolicus, was king of the Ancient Greek kingdom of Macedonia from 239 until his death in 229 BC.
